name: Park Hyatt Washington D.C.
positioning: Park Hyatt hotel in Washington, D.C.'s West End, near Washington Circle and the White House, home to Blue Duck Tavern and a Tea Cellar
best_for: Travelers who want a West End base near Foggy Bottom and Georgetown
Food and tea lovers drawn to Blue Duck Tavern and the Tea Cellar
Business travelers and event planners needing meeting space

facts.text: The hotel is in the West End near Washington Circle and the White House.
The 24-hour fitness center in the guest house features two Peloton bikes.
Rooms and suites feature American folk art and baths with natural stone finishes.
Suites offer separate living room areas and limestone bathrooms.
The Presidential Suite has separate living and dining rooms.
Rooms include Le Labo bath toiletries.
Afternoon tea is available at the Tea Cellar.
Blue Duck Tavern crafts rustic dishes from locally sourced seasonal ingredients.
Blue Duck Lounge has glass-enclosed booths beside a marble and glass bar.
The hotel is dog-friendly, with a dog bed, water bowl and treats waiting on arrival.
The hotel provides Tesla and universal electric car charging stations.
The hotel offers 12,000 square feet of meeting and event space.

highlights.text: The Tea Cellar offers more than 30 rare, single-estate teas from China, Japan, Sri Lanka and the Himalayas.
Blue Duck Tavern's open kitchen has a Molteni range and a wood-burning oven.
The hotel has a skylit saltwater pool with a separate hot tub.
The lobby has handcrafted Windsor-style furniture.

considerations.text: The hotel is not as close to the main tourist attractions as other D.C. hotels, though it borders Foggy Bottom and Georgetown.
Valet parking is available for one vehicle per room for a nightly fee.
WhataHotel notes it is an urban location without resort-style outdoor spaces.
